After the client resumes, interacting with deeply nested controls must mutate the injected store and the theme, and the fine-grained bound nodes (item quantities, the useComputed$ aggregates, and every theme consumer) must update consistently.

The verification passes only if every one of these exact values is observed in order.

    {

    }
